question: What error code appears when you try to install the VPN client on a personal laptop?
Which VPN gateway should someone based in Bangalore use?
expected_answer: vpn-in.example.com

question: Why is the India VPN gateway on TCP by default?
expected_answer: ISP filtering

question: My VPN keeps dropping every couple of minutes at home. What do I change?
expected_answer: Switch protocol UDP to TCP, reconnect, restart once

question: Does the VPN route all my internet traffic through the office?
expected_answer: No, split tunnelling: only internal addresses

question: Can warehouse staff use the VPN?
expected_answer: Not by default; request via ticket with manager approval

question: How long is a password valid before it expires?
expected_answer: 180 days

question: How many old passwords are remembered so you cannot reuse them?
Steps to change my password on a Mac, including the keychain part
expected_answer: System Settings, Users and Groups, Change Password, then update Keychain entries

question: Outlook keeps asking for my password since I changed it yesterday. Why?
expected_answer: Skipped the lock-and-unlock step; clear Credential Manager entries

question: After how many failed logins does the account lock, and for how long?
expected_answer: 5 attempts in 15 minutes, 30 minutes

question: I got a new phone and already wiped the old one. How do I get MFA working?
expected_answer: Helpdesk MFA reset, video call identity check, about 20 minutes

question: What should I do if I typed my password into a phishing page?
expected_answer: Change password immediately, inform security team same day

question: What driver do I pick when adding a printer on Windows?
expected_answer: Generic PCL6

question: Which protocol do I choose for a printer on macOS?
expected_answer: IPP

question: What does the printer name AUS-02-03 mean?
expected_answer: Austin, floor 2, printer 3

question: The printer says offline for me. Quickest fix?
expected_answer: Remove and re-add by IP address

question: My prints come out with streaks. Should I try to fix the printer?
expected_answer: No, hardware; file a low priority ticket

question: Can I print from my personal phone?
expected_answer: Not supported; email to yourself

question: When are OS updates pushed and how long do I have to restart?
expected_answer: Second Tuesday monthly, seven days

question: Laptop is crawling since this morning's update. Is something broken?
expected_answer: Indexing and scan after update, 30 to 90 minutes, two restarts

question: What should I check before opening a ticket about a slow laptop?
expected_answer: Tabs, disk space, last full restart, running sync

question: My battery does not last a two hour meeting anymore. What can I do?
expected_answer: Battery replacement under low priority ticket

question: Other people cannot hear me in Teams but I can hear them
expected_answer: Microphone permission; Settings, Devices; macOS Privacy, Microphone

question: What is the Outlook mailbox size limit and when does it warn?
expected_answer: 50 GB limit, warns at 45 GB

question: What is the smb path for the Finance shared drive on a Mac?
expected_answer: smb://files.example.com/finance

question: I get access denied on a folder in the Logistics drive. Can IT fix it?
expected_answer: No, owner team (Logistics) grants access

question: How long does a software request take to be approved?
expected_answer: 3 to 5 working days, up to 3 weeks for new software

gold.section: Requesting software not in the catalogue

question: How long does temporary admin access last and who approves it?
expected_answer: 60 minutes, your manager

question: I got a new laptop and my paid software will not activate. What happened?
expected_answer: Licence still on old device; uninstall there or file ticket with asset tag

question: My laptop sounds like a jet engine even when I'm not doing anything. Should I report it?
expected_answer: Restart first; if fans are loud at idle for more than a day after a restart, file a ticket (dust, Facilities cleans it)

question: Which VPN gateway has a maintenance window on Sundays?
expected_answer: vpn-eu.example.com, Sundays 02:00 to 04:00 CET

question: Teams shows a black screen instead of my camera. What should I try?
expected_answer: Close other apps using the camera; on Windows allow desktop apps in Privacy, Camera; sign out and back in to Teams

question: The VPN says I'm connected but my shared drive still won't open. What now?
expected_answer: Check it says Connected not Connecting, then reconnect the drive in File Explorer; if the drive letter is missing, map it with the path from the Shared drives table

gold.section: Connected but cannot reach shared drives

question: Can I add a grammar checker extension to my browser?
expected_answer: Only after a security review, because it reads page content on every site; request it like software
